verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in support for agents from several vendors (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok) plus open-source frameworks like BrowserUse, so it is not locked to one model vendor. However, the evidence never shows a developer plugging in their own LLM provider or API key, and never shows how HyperAgent is configured with an arbitrary model. missing for 10: documented bring-your-own-provider/API-key configuration, HyperAgent LLM adapter docs showing arbitrary model support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
